title: Mexican Chicken Fajitas
description: A quick and flavorful Mexican dish made with chicken, peppers, and onions, served with warm flour tortillas. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add bell peppers, onion, and almonds to the skillet. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add fajita seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Warm flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble fajitas by placing cooked chicken and vegetables onto tortillas and serving.
